content.title: How to watch USA vs. Dominican Republic
content.text: 234 New Updates Stephen J. Nesbitt · Senior Writer, MLB USA outlasts Dominican Republic in thriller Team USA has beaten the Dominican Republic 2-1 to advance to the World Baseball Classic final. The U.S. outlasted the Dominican Republic in a highly anticipated showdown that delivered on the hype. Junior Caminero homered off U.S. ace Paul Skenes to open the scoring. Gunnar Henderson answered with a solo shot off Dominican starter Luis Severino , then Roman Anthony hit a go-ahead blast off Gregory Soto . From there, relievers on both sides put up zeros. David Bednar escaped another seventh-inning jam, stranding two runners in scoring position. Garrett Whitlock pitched a clean eighth and in the ninth, Mason Miller stranded the tying run at third base, getting lucky on a strike three call to Geraldo Perdomo . The U.S. awaits the winner of Venezuela-Italy in the final. Team USA wins heavyweight bout with Dominican Republic to reach WBC final First pitch of today’s game is scheduled for shortly after 8 p.m. ET at loanDepot Park in Miami. That is a 5 p.m. PT start on the West Coast. Hello, baseball fans, and welcome to The Athletic’s live coverage of the first World Baseball Classic semifinal with a highly anticipated matchup between two powerhouses and tournament favorites as Team USA takes on the Dominican Republic at loanDepot Park in Miami. It does not get much better than this. Team USA is not playing its best ball, coming off a 5-3 win over Canada, while the D.R. is red-hot, dominating Korea 10-0 in just seven innings on Friday. Paul Skenes will get the start for the Americans, with Luis Severino getting the nod for the Dominican Republic. Two aces facing lineups loaded with All-Stars, with a spot in the WBC final on the line. From now through the final out and beyond, our team of reporters will provide the latest news, analysis, play-by-play, reaction and more.
